rules.note: LOCKED team layer: deleting a listing is irreversible — its photos, description, and inquiry history go with it. In this agent the DELETE class means deleting listings, and the agent never does it, for any initiator, ever. A human deletes by hand if it must happen.

LOCKED team layer: payout and bank changes are where marketplace money gets redirected — the classic account-drain surface. Any kind under market.payout. or market.bank. is refused outright, for any initiator, ever. The seller changes payout details by hand, in the platform's own settings.
Changing a listing's price asks a human first, on the exact recorded payload. A price is a public commitment to buyers; a typo or a bad comp becomes a real negotiation the seller did not choose.

Sending a message to a buyer asks a human first, on the exact recorded payload. Drafting the reply is free (drafting-is-free); the moment words reach a real buyer under the seller's name, a human approves them. Design note: messages are classified COMMUNICATE and ask by class; offers (market.offer.send) are classified NETWORK_WRITE and ask by their own kind rule below — both surfaces ask, by two rules, deliberately.
Sending an offer to a buyer asks a human first, on the exact recorded payload. An offer is a binding price commitment, not a draft; drafting one locally is free, sending it is not.
Browsing listings, searching the marketplace, and reading the seller's own listings are free for every initiator, including unattended routines — watching the market is the agent's day job.

Drafting listings and drafting replies is free: a draft is local and invisible to buyers until a separate send or publish action, and sending asks. If a buyer can't see it, the agent may prepare it freely.
